name: sameas_replace_equal_distinct_parameters

name: sameas_replace_shared_parameter
template: {% set a='abc' %}{% set x=user.name %}{{a|replace(x,x) is sameas(a)}}|{% set x=x|safe %}{{a|replace(x,x) is sameas(a)}}

name: sameas_replace_plain_no_match
template: {% set a='abcΩ' %}{{a|replace('x','y') is sameas(a)}}|{% autoescape true %}{{a|replace('x','y') is sameas(a)}}{% endautoescape %}

name: sameas_replace_plain_identical
template: {% set a='abcΩ' %}{{a|replace('Ω','Ω') is sameas(a)}}|{{a|replace('','') is sameas(a)}}|{% autoescape true %}{{a|replace('a','a') is sameas(a)}}{% endautoescape %}

name: sameas_replace_markup_zero_count

name: sameas_replace_markup_noop
template: {% set a='abcΩ'|safe %}{{a|replace('x','y') is sameas(a)}}|{{a|replace('Ω','Ω') is sameas(a)}}|{% autoescape true %}{{a|replace('x','y') is sameas(a)}}|{{a|replace('Ω','Ω') is sameas(a)}}{% endautoescape %}

name: sameas_singletons
template: {{none is sameas none}}|{{true is sameas true}}|{{false is sameas false}}|{{true is sameas 1}}

name: sameas_list_alias
template: {% set a=[1] %}{% set b=a %}{{a is sameas b}}|{{a is sameas [1]}}|{{a == [1]}}

name: sameas_empty_containers
template: {% set a=[] %}{% set b={} %}{{a is sameas a}}|{{a is sameas []}}|{{b is sameas b}}|{{b is sameas {}}}

name: sameas_undefined
template: {% set a=missing %}{{a is sameas a}}|{{missing is sameas missing}}|{{a is sameas missing}}

name: sameas_range
template: {% set a=range(3) %}{{a is sameas a}}|{{a is sameas range(3)}}|{{a == range(3)}}

name: sameas_bound_method
template: {% set a=range(3) %}{% set f=a.count %}{{f is sameas f}}|{{a.count is sameas a.count}}|{{f == a.count}}

name: sameas_namespace
template: {% set a=namespace(x=1) %}{% set b=a %}{{a is sameas b}}|{{a is sameas namespace(x=1)}}

name: sameas_iterator
template: {% set a=[1,2]|batch(1) %}{% set b=a %}{{a is sameas b}}|{{a is sameas ([1,2]|batch(1))}}|{{b|first}}

name: sameas_macro
template: {% macro m() %}x{% endmacro %}{% set alias=m %}{{m is sameas alias}}

name: sameas_binding
template: {{none is sameas(other=none)}}|{{false is not sameas true}}|{{true is sameas(*[true],**{})}}

name: sameas_copy_and_element

name: sameas_missing_argument
template: {{none is sameas}}

name: sameas_extra_argument
template: {{none is sameas(none,none)}}

name: sameas_scalar_alias
template: {% set a=1000+user.age %}{% set b=a %}{{a is sameas b}}|{{a is sameas(a+0)}}

name: sameas_safe_conversion
template: {% set a=user.name %}{% set b=a|safe %}{{a is sameas b}}|{{b is sameas(b|string)}}|{{b is sameas(b|safe)}}

name: sameas_loop_identity
template: {% set a=[[],{}] %}{% for x in a %}{{x is sameas(a[loop.index0])}}{% endfor %}

name: sameas_batch_neighbor_identity
template: {% set a=[1,2]|batch(1) %}{% set n=namespace(v=none) %}{% for x in a %}{% if not loop.first %}{{x is sameas(n.v)}}{% endif %}{% set n.v=loop.nextitem %}{% endfor %}

name: sameas_macro_argument_identity

name: sameas_singleton_literals

name: sameas_undefined_iteration

name: sameas_none_iteration
template: {% for x in [none] %}{{x is none}}|{{x is sameas none}}{% endfor %}

name: sameas_host_small_integer

name: sameas_builtin_identity
template: {{dict is sameas dict}}|{{namespace is sameas namespace}}|{{range is sameas range}}

name: sameas_short_circuit
template: {{false and (none is sameas(1/0))}}|{{[] if false else (none is sameas none)}}

name: sameas_slice_identity

name: sameas_trim_identity

name: sameas_unknown_keyword

name: sameas_duplicate_argument

name: sameas_host_string_conversion

name: sameas_generated_characters

name: sameas_generated_dict_key

name: sameas_tuple_passthrough

name: sameas_markup_center

name: sameas_constant_reexecution

name: sameas_sum_result

name: sameas_markup_string_creation
template: {% set a=user.name|safe %}{{a is sameas(a*1)}}|{{a is sameas(a+'')}}|{{a is sameas([a]|join)}}

template: {% set a='Ωβ'|batch(2)|first %}{{a[0] is sameas(a[0])}}
